article.headline: Strack, Swords lead way as No. 11 Kentucky women roll to 74-28 win over Maine
article.description: — Clara Strack scored 21 points, backup forward Savannah Swords scored 15, and No. 11 Kentucky overwhelmed Maine 74-28 on Friday at the Daytona Beach Classic.
article.linkText: Strack, Swords lead way as No. 11 Kentucky women roll to 74-28 win over Maine
article.story: DAYTONA BEACH, Fla. -- — Clara Strack scored 21 points, backup forward Savannah Swords scored 15, and No. 11 Kentucky overwhelmed Maine 74-28 on Friday at the Daytona Beach Classic. It was the first double-digit scoring game for the freshman Swords. Kentucky (7-0) turned 21 Maine turnovers into 21 points while Maine scored only three points following nine Kentucky turnovers. The Black Bears (4-3) shot 22% overall, including missing on all 16 of their 3-point tries. Kentucky shot 48% and made 7-of-16 3-pointers (44%). Kentucky's 17-0 scoring run in the first quarter resulted in a 19-2 lead and the Wildcats led 24-5 heading to the second period. Kentucky also dominated the second quarter and Bailey Breen's layup in the final minute finally got the Black Bears into double digits on the scoreboard. Kentucky led 44-11 at halftime. Maddie Fitzpatrick scored seven of Maine's nine points in the third quarter while Kentucky extended the lead to 60-20. Kentucky held the Black Bears to single digits in all four quarters. Fitzpatrick led Maine with seven points. Up next The event continues on Saturday. The Wildcats will play South Dakota State; Maine will take on Tulane. ------ Sign up for Top 25 poll alerts here, visit the Top 25 here and see AP’s full college basketball coverage here.
